metadata.title: HPC Behavioral Monitoring

props.name: capability
props.remarks: Business capability for detecting anomalous, abusive, or malicious behavior in HPC jobs and workloads that may otherwise comply with static policy.

props.name: technology-domain
props.remarks: HPC job telemetry, scheduler metrics, performance counters, resource utilization streams, and behavioral analytics.

props.name: architecture-pattern
props.remarks: Pattern for detecting anomalous or malicious behavior in scheduler-mediated HPC workloads.

props.name: depends-on
props.remarks: Behavioral monitoring builds on trusted scheduler telemetry and execution metadata.

props.name: nist-guidance
props.remarks: Behavioral monitoring, insider misuse detection, and anomaly analysis as described in NIST SP 800-234.

metadata.remarks: HPC Behavioral Monitoring defines trust properties for detecting misuse in high-performance computing environments where threats often arise from legitimate users and jobs. This pattern focuses on runtime behavior rather than static configuration violations.

components.title: HPC Job Behavior Anomaly Detection
components.description: Detection of anomalous HPC job behavior relative to expected execution patterns.

props.name: attack-technique
props.remarks: Masquerading or misuse through jobs that appear legitimate but behave abnormally.

props.name: defense-technique
props.remarks: Analysis of job execution behavior to detect deviations from expected patterns.

implemented-requirements.remarks: Monitoring of HPC job execution for indicators of misuse.
Analysis of job execution logs and telemetry for suspicious behavior.

components.title: HPC Resource Usage Anomaly Detection
components.description: Detection of abnormal resource consumption patterns indicating abuse or compromise.

props.name: attack-technique
props.remarks: Denial-of-service or covert misuse via abnormal resource consumption.

props.name: defense-technique
props.remarks: Continuous monitoring of HPC resource utilization to detect anomalies.

implemented-requirements.remarks: Detection of resource exhaustion or misuse impacting availability.
Continuous monitoring of workload behavior and platform health.

components.title: HPC Insider Misuse Detection
components.description: Identification of malicious or policy-violating activity by legitimate users or jobs.

props.name: attack-technique
props.remarks: Abuse of valid accounts to perform unauthorized or harmful actions.

props.name: defense-technique
props.remarks: Analysis of user and job behavior over time to detect misuse.

implemented-requirements.remarks: Insider threat monitoring for HPC environments.
Collection and correlation of telemetry relevant to insider threat detection.
